modules.title: Introduction to Articles of Faith (Iman)
modules.html:
Belief in Allah, His angels, His books, His prophets, the Day of Judgement and divine destiny. This section covers introduction to articles of faith (iman).

Key points

  • The Surah that describes the short duration of time and the importance of faith and good deeds is _____. — Surat al-Asr.
  • The Surah that describes the short duration of time and importance of faith is _____. — Suratul-Asr.
  • What is the meaning of 'Iman' — Faith/Belief.
  • The belief in the Angels is the ___ pillar of Iman — 2nd.

Worked examples

Q: The Surah that describes the short duration of time and the importance of faith and good deeds is _____.
A: Surat al-Asr — Surat al-Asr emphasizes that all mankind is in a state of loss except those who have faith, do good, and encourage truth and patience.

Q: The Surah that describes the short duration of time and importance of faith is _____.
A: Suratul-Asr — Suratul-Asr declares that all mankind is in loss except those with faith, good deeds, and who encourage truth and patience.

examples.q: The Surah that describes the short duration of time and the importance of faith and good deeds is _____.
The Surah that describes the short duration of time and importance of faith is _____.

quiz.q: What is the meaning of 'Iman'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Faith/Belief.

quiz.q: The belief in the Angels is the ___ pillar of Iman?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: 2nd.

quiz.q: The ritual of 'Sa'y' during Hajj involves walking between the hills of _____.
quiz.solution: Sa'y commemorates Hajar's (AS) search for water for her son Ismail (AS) between the hills of Safa and Marwa.

quiz.q: The act of 'Tayammum' is performed when _____ is unavailable.
quiz.solution: Tayammum is dry ablution using clean earth/sand when water is not available or its use is harmful to health.

quiz.q: The 'Iddah' period for a divorced woman who is not pregnant is _____.
quiz.solution: The Qur'an specifies three monthly cycles (Quru') for a divorced woman to ensure there is no pregnancy before she remarries.

quiz.q: The Surah that warns against backbiting and slandering is _____.
quiz.solution: Surat al-Humazah begins by condemning 'every slanderer and backbiter'.

quiz.q: The act of 'Istighfar' means _____.
quiz.solution: Istighfar is the act of saying 'Astaghfirullah' (I seek Allah's forgiveness).

quiz.q: The first revelation came to the Prophet in the Cave of _____.
quiz.solution: Mount Nur houses the Cave of Hira, where Angel Jibril first commanded the Prophet to 'Read!' (Iqra).

quiz.q: The 'Year of Elephant' (Amul-Fil) is significant because it was the year _____.
quiz.solution: Prophet Muhammad (SAW) was born in 570 CE, the year Abrahah Al-Ashram attempted to destroy the Ka'bah with an army of elephants.

quiz.q: The 'As-Sab' al-Mathani' mentioned in the Qur'an refers to _____.
quiz.solution: Suratul-Fatihah is referred to as the seven oft-repeated verses because it is mandatory in every rak'ah of prayer.

quiz.q: The companion who narrated the highest number of Hadiths was _____.
quiz.solution: Abu Hurayrah (RA) spent years in close company with the Prophet specifically to learn and memorize his teachings.
